title: Simulation of a clean call
statement: Let $B$ be a finite Boolean machine with at least one work tape, and let $q_v,q_i$ be designated states and $stop$ a Boolean parameter. Suppose that on input $x$, the run of $B$ from state $q$ with $s$ on tape zero and all other work tapes empty halts after $T$ steps with output $y$. Then, for some $t\le 3T+|x|+|y|+8$, the body machine starting in the clean-call state corresponding to $q$ and mode $mode$, with candidate $s$ on tape zero, blank capture tape, all other tapes blank, endpoint heads at $0$, and empty output, reaches the administrative continuation state specified by $mode$. At that time the candidate $s$ is preserved, the capture tape contains $y$, all other tapes are blank, both endpoint heads are at $0$, and the output is empty.
